words.title: Share this match
words.about: To make a reel, this match goes to throwingwood.com and gets its own link. Anyone with the link can watch the replay and the reel, for a year.
words.label: Name on the reel
words.sides: Your side is shown by this name. The other side is Computer. Nothing else about you is sent.
words.when: The score sheet shows the day and time the match was played.
words.failed: This match could not be shared.
words.notThisTime: This match could not be shared. Not this time.

name.empty: Type a name for your side.
name.you: A reel needs a name, not "You".
name.spaces: No spaces at the start or end.
